milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The pink bed is now placed just outside the structure entrance at spawn-relative (~7, ~1, ~4.5). The player spawns at origin facing roughly east — the pink bed is NOT visible from spawn (confirmed in sandbox preview: it's behind the structure wall from the initial view angle). The player must turn and walk ~8.4 blocks to reach it. max_distance=10 is generous enough to allow detection from a reasonable range while being tighter than the previous 16 to add meaningful navigation. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the bed.

Uses inventory_has because mining a bed drops it as an item into the player's inventory. The white bed is placed inside the wooden structure at spawn-relative (~7, ~1, ~8-9). When the player breaks either half of the white bed, the entire bed breaks and drops a 'white_bed' item which appears in their inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory so this cannot be pre-satisfied. No tool is required — beds break instantly with bare hands.
